clauses.text: The switchboard shall be designed, manufactured and verified in accordance with BS EN 61439-2.
Internal separation shall be Form 4 Type 4 as defined in the UK National Annex.
The assembly shall withstand a prospective short-circuit current of 50 kA for 1 second at the main busbars.
Outgoing moulded-case circuit breakers shall be 3-pole with adjustable thermal-magnetic or electronic trip units.
Degree of protection shall be not less than IP41 with doors closed.
Main busbars shall be hard-drawn high-conductivity copper, tin-plated at joints.
The contractor shall provide type-test or design-verification certificates prior to manufacture.
Witness testing at the manufacturer's works shall be allowed for.
